tools.name: audit_domain
tools.description: Audit an email domain in one call: can it receive mail (MX), can it be spoofed (SPF/DMARC/DKIM posture), disposable check. Returns {can_receive, can_be_spoofed, score, reasons, checks}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_domain · Public sink: audit_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_domain · Public sink: audit_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
